execution_space: all scalar-and-bijective-encoding pairs in a finite group-label program
theorem_scope: first informative hits at stages 2 through m-1, with q=field cardinality and injective scalar map
stage_bound: (q-k*k) times first-hit execution count at k <= k times live execution count at k
aggregate_bound: (q-m*m) times sum of first-hit execution counts for 2<=k<m <= m*m times execution-space cardinality
falsifiers: an exhaustive Z/7 actual stage violates the stage inequality
the sum of any frozen Z/101 bucket subset violates the summed inequality
Lean admits a nonstandard axiom in the final stage or aggregate theorem
